body:
Fentanyl wow
Wow, ok, I had done the patches before this, but I picked up my brother and his friend from school one day.  I took his friend by his house and he just gave me a 100 microgram fentanyl patch.  So I slapped it on my back and we went to the mall.  I waited for like 2 or 3 hours and felt nothing.  Well, while at the mall, I started feeling really warm and just a helluva body buzz.  Later that night, I was up just nodding off and itching like a mo fo.  The next morning, I was taking my brother to school, and I lost it.  I had my truck door open the whole way puking.  I got home and ripped it off and gave it away.  It was a 72 hour patch and I barely made it a day.  It kicked my ass!
